title: Ready to Die at 32
hook: 32 years ago this month, Ready to Die dropped.
voiceover: 32 years ago this month, Ready to Die dropped. September 13, 1994, Bad Boy Records. Everyone posts the baby on the cover. The part nobody posts is the intro, and it's a DJ set. The first 3 minutes of the album tell Big's life through records. He's born to Curtis Mayfield's Superfly. He's a kid to Rapper's Delight. He's a teenager robbing a train to Audio Two's Top Billin'. He walks out of prison to Snoop's Tha Shiznit, which had only been out about 10 months. Puffy scored a biography with 4 records and no narration, and every head in Brooklyn knew exactly what year each scene was. Where were you when this dropped?
caption: Ready to Die, The Notorious B.I.G., Bad Boy, September 13, 1994. 32 years. The intro is a DJ set of his life: Superfly for the birth, Rapper's Delight for childhood, Top Billin' for the train robbery, Tha Shiznit for walking out of prison. Four records, no narration, and you knew the year of every scene. Where were you when this dropped? 🗽
